name: Word Of Knowledge
overview: The Word of Knowledge is rooted in the unchanging and powerful Word of God, which accomplishes His purposes without fail (Isaiah 55:11; Matthew 24:35). It emphasizes the necessity of divine revelation and understanding, as God's people suffer destruction when they reject knowledge (Hosea 4:6). The Holy Spirit plays a vital role in imparting this knowledge, teaching and reminding believers of Christ's teachings (John 14:26), and empowering them to be effective witnesses of the gospel (Acts 1:8). This demonstrates that the Word of Knowledge is both a divine communication and an enabling power for faithful service (Ezekiel 13:1).
